title: A small-molecule VHL molecular glue degrader for cysteine dioxygenase 1.
authors: Tutter, Antonin; Buckley, Dennis; Golosov, Andrei A; Ma, Xiaolei; Shu, Wei; McKay, Daniel J J; Darsigny, Veronique; Dovala, Dustin; Beckwith, Rohan; Solomon, Jonathan; Rao, Pasupuleti; Xu, Lei; Fazal, Aleem; Lingel, Andreas; Wartchow, Charles; Cobb, Jennifer S; Hachey, Amanda; Tullai, Jennifer; Michaud, Gregory A
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小分子分子胶降解剂介导VHL与CDO1蛋白的互作，虽涉及蛋白-蛋白复合物建模与MD模拟，但对象为蛋白-蛋白而非蛋白-DNA互作，与本课题TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: The von Hippel-Lindau tumor suppressor gene product (pVHL) is an E3 ligase substrate receptor that binds proline-hydroxylated hypoxia-inducible factor HIF1alpha, leading to its ubiquitin-dependent degradation. By using protein arrays, we identified a small molecule that binds the HIF1alpha-binding pocket on pVHL and functions as a molecular glue degrader of the neosubstrate cysteine dioxygenase (CDO1) by recruiting it into the VHL-Cullin-RING E3 ligase complex and leading to its selective degradation. The CDO1-binding region involved in VHL recruitment was characterized through a combination of mutagenesis and protein-protein docking coupled with molecular-dynamics-based solvation analysis. The X-ray structure of the ternary complexes of VHL, CDO1 and degrader molecules confirms the binding region prediction and provides atomic insights into key molecular glue interactions.
abstract_zh: von Hippel-Lindau肿瘤抑制基因产物（pVHL）是一种E3连接酶底物受体，其结合脯氨酸羟化的缺氧诱导因子HIF1alpha，导致其泛素依赖性降解。通过使用蛋白质阵列，我们鉴定了一种小分子，该小分子结合pVHL上的HIF1alpha结合口袋，并作为新底物半胱氨酸双加氧酶（CDO1）的分子胶降解剂，通过将其招募至VHL-Cullin-RING E3连接酶复合物并导致其选择性降解。涉及VHL招募的CDO1结合区域通过诱变和蛋白质-蛋白质对接结合基于分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 的溶剂化分析进行了表征。VHL、CDO1和降解剂分子三元复合物的X射线结构证实了结合区域预测，并为关键分子胶相互作用提供了原子层面的见解。
